ExpansionMain_Moana/Moana_VLG_Gast_040_V.en: I constantly ask myself that same question.
I wish I knew the answer.
I am Princess Vanellope von Schweetz!
Does that sound like the name of a sidekick to you?
ExpansionMain_Moana/Moana_VLG_Gast_040_V.cz: Zní ti to jako jméno nějakého pomocníka?
